package com.viciousliqx.viciousbars;

/**
 * Restored from v1 (see git log before the full-reset "gut pass") -
 * unchanged. Where the icon/counter cluster sits along a bar's length,
 * independent of orientation - same pattern as {@link DockSide#orientation()}.
 * START is left on a horizontal bar or top on a vertical bar, END is right
 * or bottom.
 */
public enum Justification
{
	START,
	CENTER,
	END
}
